AbouttheTutorial 
 
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is Amazon’s cloud web hosting platform that offers flexible, 
reliable, scalable, easy-to-use, and cost-effective solutions. This tutorial covers various 
important topics illustrating how AWS works and how it is beneficial to run your website 
on Amazon Web Services.

Cloud computing is an internet-based computing service in which large groups of remote 
servers are networked to allow centralized data storage, and online access to computer 
services or resources.
